Glass Mosaic

Vibrant. Elegant. Versatile.

Scroll down
01

Overview

About Glass Mosaic

Glass mosaic is made from small coloured glass tiles that hold their shine and colour. It is a classic choice for swimming pools and also works beautifully in bathrooms, kitchens and feature walls.

Glass mosaic tiles that hold their colour and shine for years. Perfect for swimming pools, bathrooms, kitchens and decorative walls.

Enquire about thisSee all types
02

Types & quality

Choose the right Glass Mosaic

Swatches are digital renderings that show the look of each type. The real product's colour and finish can vary a little.

Pools

Crystal glass mosaic

Clear, glossy glass tiles with deep colour and strong shine. The classic choice for swimming pools.

Best for: Pools, feature walls

Bathroom floors

Frosted (matt) glass

A matt, etched surface that softens reflections and feels less slippery than glossy glass.

Best for: Bathroom floors, steam rooms

Accent walls

Iridescent (pearl) glass

A thin coating shifts colour with the light angle, from teal to lilac. A decorative, eye-catching finish.

Best for: Accent walls, spas

Backsplashes

Metallic (gold / foil) glass

Metal-foil layers or coatings give a gold or silver shine. Best on walls, away from heavy wear.

Best for: Backsplashes, feature walls

Pools

Mixed-colour blend

Several colours on one sheet for a natural, varied look. Hides small colour differences between batches.

Best for: Pools, kitchens, feature walls

Bathrooms

Crackle (ice) glass

Fine crack patterns inside each tile give a frosted-ice effect with a soft, light look.

Best for: Bathrooms, kitchen walls

GlassColour oxidesMesh sheet backing

07

Material guide

Know your material

What it is

Glass mosaic is made of small glass tiles, usually mounted on mesh sheets for quick fixing.

How it is made

Coloured glass is melted, formed and cut into tiles, then mounted onto sheets.

Installation tip

Use an adhesive made for glass and wet areas, and waterproof the surface before tiling.

Strengths

  • Non-porous, so water does not soak in
  • Bright colours that do not fade
  • Smooth, easy-to-clean surface

Good to know

  • Needs a flat surface and careful fixing
  • Many grout lines to keep clean
08

FAQ

Common questions

Can it be used in a pool?

Yes, glass mosaic is widely used in pools. Use the right adhesive and grout.

Which grout colour works best?

Match the grout to the tile for a seamless look, or contrast it to highlight the pattern.

09

Care & maintenance

Easy to look after

  1. 01

    Wipe with a soft cloth and mild glass cleaner.

  2. 02

    Avoid harsh abrasive pads.

  3. 03

    Check grout joints once a year.
